summary: Build secure, valid, and defensible assessment systems with practical tools, moderation methods, and results governance. Enrol now.
lede: Assessment and examination management brings planning, delivery and review together to support fair, secure testing and defensible results. For professionals who oversee testing, marking or academic quality, the training covers examination blueprinting and item writing, moderation and marking controls, and secure operations and results review. It also introduces item analysis, including AI-assisted review, with attention to where human oversight remains essential.
audienceIntro: This advanced assessment and examination management training is built for professionals who already support testing, marking, or academic quality and now need stronger control over validity, fairness, and defensible results.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in examination administration, assessment coordination, quality assurance, learning design, or academic registry operations. Prior exposure to test design, marking processes, or quality review is helpful, but no programming is required. Advanced topics such as item analysis and AI-assisted assessment review are taught at an operational level, not as statistical engineering. You should bring a laptop and, where possible, sample assessment policies, marking rubrics, examination timetables, item banks, or anonymized results reports from your own context.
